To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Fe 2 O 3 -rGO composites with a low content of Fe 2 O3 exhibit excellent microwave absorption performance.
we have successfully synthesized monodispersed Fe 3 O4 nanoparticles on rGO nanosheets with the assistance of polydopamine.

the Fe 2 O 3 /rGO composite with a thickness of about 3 mm exhibits an optimum reflection loss of 71.9 dB at a low loading of 20% Fe 2 O3, which is superior to most Fe3O4/graphene composites, and that the effective absorbing bandwidth is 4.1GHz.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of monodispersed Fe 3 O4 NPs on rGO nanosheets and the study of their microwave absorption properties.
the preparation and microwave absorption properties of the monodisperse Fe 3 O4 /rGO nanocomposite.
the synthesis and microwave absorption properties of ultrasmall Fe _{3} O _{4} /rGO nanocomposites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work is the first time to synthesize the Fe 3O 4 /r-GO composite with a high absorption of 71 dB at a low loading of 20wt% and a wide bandwidth of 4.1GHz by a facile method.
the synthesis of Fe 3 O4 /rGO nanocomposites by a facile one-step method is an efficient way to achieve excellent microwave absorption performance.
the present study provides an effective approach for the preparation of Fe3O4/rGO composites with excellent microwave absorbing properties.

the microwave absorption properties of Fe 3 O4 /graphene hybrids are strongly dependent on the particle size, the thickness and the content of the hybrids.

we can use the Fe3O4/rGO composites as microwave absorbers.
